compatibility_rules: A schema id's major version (…/N) never changes meaning; breaking changes mint …/N+1.
Additive optional fields are allowed within a major version; readers MUST ignore unknown optional fields only where additionalProperties allows them.
Controllers read N and N-1 of PK_CONTROLLER_STATE; writers always emit N.
Removing an enum member, a required field, or changing a type is breaking.
Error codes (PK_ERROR/1) are append-only; retired codes are never reused.
